verdicts.reason: A just shrinks the banner content into the story canvas: the headline is small with dead orange space above and below it, the tagline 'Now in four flavours' is tiny and hard to read, and the elements are spread far apart, so the button floats on its own with a weak, undersized CTA. B rewraps the headline into a large four-line stack that clearly dominates and makes the tagline and button readable. Its flaws are a large empty band between the tagline and the CTA, the CTA still sitting small in the lower third, and the group not quite filling the vertical format, so it needs spacing work before it ships.
